Sam wrote about the day in the diary. Sam learned a lot about music. Last Saturday, Sam and Mia went to the city square. Best of all, the installation of the new lights took two hours.
Sam borrowed a book about music from the supermarket. Sam drinks coffee after doing sports. It takes twenty minutes to get to the city square by bike. Also, the show was really funny.

They took many photos at the pedestrian street. There are always many people at the pedestrian street. Sam thinks music is interesting but a little difficult. The show's finale was an orgy of color and music.
Mia is interested in singing. Sam wants to be a doctor in the future. The weather was sunny that day.
